title: Inspect C-compatible record layouts
description: You can compare field declarations with ctypes sizes and offsets reported by the supplied run.

steps.description: Point declares two double fields. Rect contains two Point fields.
The supplied run measures Point as 16 bytes and Rect as 32. Point's field offsets are 0 and 8.

steps.question: Does sizeof(Padded) equal the sum 1 + 4 + 2 in this recording?
steps.answer: No. It reports 12 bytes, with offsets 0, 4, and 8.

steps.description: The field-size comments differ from the measured complete record size. The offset display makes the intervening space visible.
The snippet creates byref(v), but magnitude_python receives v directly. Its displayed magnitude is 5.0000; no foreign function is called here.
The final section constructs five C integers and displays their values. This recording measures the array as 20 bytes.
